agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/tokens.py TruncateStringFilter.process: the condition for identifying string literals was inverted (`ttype == T.Literal.String.Single` guarding the pass-through branch), causing actual string literals to be left untouched while identifiers and other tokens were incorrectly truncated. Changed to `!=` so only String.Single literals are truncated, restoring correct behavior. Verified with manual sqlparse.format calls: string literals truncate correctly with the configured char suffix, and identifiers are no longer truncated.
